description: This file defines the interface and classes for custom autograd functions in PyTorch, including Function templates, AutogradContext, and CppNode classes, with mechanisms for forward/backward passes, saving variables, and integrating with Python autograd.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: Template class for defining custom autograd functions with static forward and backward methods, supporting traceability.

classes.name: AutogradContext
classes.description: Context class for saving data during forward pass to be used in backward, including mechanisms for saving variables, marking dirty/non-differentiable, and managing gradients.

classes.name: CppNode
classes.description: Node class representing user-defined backward functions in the autograd graph, with methods for applying, saving, and releasing variables, and integrating with Python.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method to instantiate and run the custom autograd function with given arguments.

methods.name: save_for_backward
methods.description: Saves variables for use in backward pass.

methods.name: mark_non_differentiable
methods.description: Marks outputs as not requiring gradients.

methods.name: set_materialize_grads
methods.description: Sets whether to expand undefined output gradients to zeros.

methods.name: apply_with_saved
methods.description: Applies the node with saved variables.
